author: sbutnari
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure step fails at step 13; same MODULE_LIBRARY link error as prior Android arm64 failures in this series

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_android
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status failure due to Build x64 CMake configure failure

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.
  Call Stack:
    cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
    cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
    CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
root_cause: The Android CMake build (both arm64 and x64 matrix variants) fails because plugins such as openvino_intel_gpu_plugin are built as MODULE_LIBRARY targets, but ov_generate_plugins_hpp/ov_target_link_plugins in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 attempts to link them into another target, which CMake forbids. This is a pre-existing, ongoing infrastructure bug in the Android build configuration (first seen 2026-08-08, now 20 occurrences) that is entirely unrelated to PR #37401, which only modifies src/plugins/intel_npu/tests/driver_version.json. The run was already automatically retried (attempt 2 is in_progress) but is expected to fail again for the same reason.
reproduction_steps: Build OpenVINO for Android with ENABLE_INTEL_GPU=ON targeting arm64-v8a or x86_64 ABI; the CMake configure step will fail with the MODULE_LIBRARY link error.
recommended_actions: The Android CMake MODULE_LIBRARY issue must be fixed in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake before the Android workflow becomes usable again.
PR #37401 (NPU driver version update) is unrelated to this failure and can be merged once the underlying Android build issue is resolved or the Android check is made non-blocking.
Consider making the Android workflow non-blocking or skipping it for PRs that don't touch Android/GPU plugin code while the underlying issue persists.
prevention_strategies: Fix ov_generate_plugins_hpp/ov_target_link_plugins in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake to not attempt linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets. Alternatively, adjust the Android build so GPU plugin targets are SHARED_LIBRARY instead of MODULE_LIBRARY.
historical_context: This exact error has been recorded 19 times since 2026-08-08 across multiple PRs (latest in the series: run 32131585279 at 11:41:46 UTC today). It is a known pre-existing bug in the Android CMake configuration, not caused by individual PRs.
